messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — v2.3.1 rollout scheduled TOMORROW 23:00 UTC. Draft release notes below, please 1) ops sanity-check deploy steps and rollback lanes, 2) confirm version pins, 3) legal quick-eyes on copy.
Deploybot: Scheduled canary: 23:10 UTC -> full rollout 23:40 UTC if canary success. Canary size = 5% traffic. Monitor thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% or latency P95 > 800ms triggers automatic pause.
Sophie R: Thanks — are we still pinning model-serving to v3.2.0 for this? last-minute quant change earlier. :eyes:
Alex G: Yes, model-serving pinned to v3.2.0 in the deployment manifest. No float. Also pinning redis-cache to 6.2.
Brian O: Any DB migrations? If yes we need +30m change window.
Maya Chen: No schema changes. Only config toggles and model binary swap. Change window is 45m total with 15m warmup.
Sophie R: Draft RN copy below. LegalBot could you skim for compliance-y phrasing?
Maya Chen: ```
- v2.3.1: improve inference routing reliability and reduce cold-start latency for long-context sessions
- Fix: tokenization edge-case causing sporadic hallucination on very short prompts
- Ops: model-serving v3.2.0 (quant) pinned; redis 6.2 pinned; no DB migrations
- Rollback: automatic fallback to model-serving v3.1.4 if canary errors exceed threshold
```
Alex G: Deploy steps for ops: 
1) kick canary: `./deploy --env=prod --tag=v2.3.1 --canary=5%`
2) watch canary dashboard (link: https://dash.internal/canary/946372)
3) if canary OK -> `./deploy --promote --tag=v2.3.1`
4) verify traffic shift and KV cache priming metrics
Brian O: Rollback commands: `./deploy --promote --tag=v2.3.1 --rollback-to=v2.3.0` AND `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving --to-revision=3`
Sophie R: What are our canary SLO checks? I want them in the RN.
Alex G: Canary checks: errors 5xx <= 0.5%, user-facing latency P95 <= 800ms, model output drift (eval set BLEU-like) no regression > 2%.
Maya Chen: Adding those. Also adding an ops contact list in the RN and an evacuation lane: if canary pauses, oncall -> runbook page and then full rollback if unresolved after 20m.
Deploybot: Reminder: deploybot will post status, canary start, promote, and pause events here automatically. Configure slack notifications to include failure alerts.
LegalBot: Quick read, ok on wording for customer-facing bits — avoid "hallucination" public-facing. Suggest "incorrect outputs" in public copy.
Maya Chen: Good catch, switching to "incorrect outputs" for external RN. Internal RN will keep the technical term.
Sophie R: tl;dr: RN done, ops steps + rollback commands included, pins confirmed, legal tweak noted. Approving for internal announce. :thumbsup:
Alex G: I'll run the canary at 23:10 UTC and monitor. Posting final RN to internal blast channel 22:45 UTC for ops + CS heads.
Brian O: I'll be on standby 22:50-00:30 UTC. Ping me if canary pause.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Final ask: please react with :eyes: when you've read and are on-call/planned.
Sophie R: :eyes:
Alex G: :eyes:
Brian O: :eyes:
